items.text: RT by @firstadopter: The Financial Times reported that NVIDIA is going to backstop a $50B lease for a data center in Texas. But @firstadopter argues the headline doesn't tell the full story. The $50B figure only applies if NVIDIA renews the lease after 15 years, bringing the total lease value to $50B over 30 years, or roughly $1B to $2B/year. A $1B to $2B annual commitment is "a rounding error" for NVIDIA, which is generating roughly $320B in annual revenue, according to Tae Kim. "This is not a story, but this is how people run with sensationalized headlines and people panic and freak out."

items.text: Mainstream media really needs to stop with these sensationalized, conflated FUD headlines. I get it, you want to generate clicks. But you’re misleading your audience. FT headline: "Nvidia behind $50 billion lease on Texas data centre that will use its chips" Over 30 years after renewals?
